mina: Heads-up  rolling out a small but important policy change for Private/VPC customers on 2026-07-15. Two customer-facing bits: (1) maintenance holdback flag (controls whether scheduled maintenance counts against SLA) and (2) a grace-mode for legacy static keys.

Key bullets:
- maintenance_holdback: tenant-level boolean. When set and backed by signed amendment, scheduled windows are excluded from SLA calculations.
- legacy_key_grace: existing static keys get a 30-day grace after GA; after that we rotate to ephemeral unless customer signs an extension.

Customer impact: minimal for SDK users. Manual config users will need to update their tenant record or swap keys. Air-gapped: we provide signed amendment templates + offline rotation bundles.

Short CLI examples:
```
# mark tenant as maintenance-exempt (requires contract_amend.pdf uploaded)
rwctl tenant-config set --tenant TID --maintenance_holdback true --contract ./contract_amend.pdf
# extend legacy key grace for 90d (sales approval required)
rwctl tenant-keys extend --tenant TID --days 90 --approved-by sales:acct
```

Action items:
- SEs: contact customers with scheduled windows and share amendment template (oliver + gwen).
- Docs: add amendment sample & migration steps (patrick).
- Security: validate audit artifacts and ensure HMAC export is toggled on by default for amended tenants (security-bot).
- Ops: plan canary and patch window 2026-07-12 01:00-03:00 UTC (ops-bot).
